# CASB

Scan SaaS applications and cloud environments for data security issues

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/cloud-and-saas/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Cloud and SaaS integrations](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/integrations/cloud-and-saas/index.md): Cloud and SaaS integrations resources and guides for Zero Trust integrations.
